## Session

**Advisor:** Last time you said you'd call the three customers who cancelled in
July and ask what they replaced you with, by August 6. The test was: you can name
all three replacements out loud. Did you?

**Founder:** Yeah. Two went back to spreadsheets and one moved to Airtable. All
three said the same thing, that they never got their team to actually log in.

## Must

- Grade this as done
- Ask what surprised the founder, or otherwise mine the result for what was learned

## Must not

- Grade this as partial, not done, or avoided
- Re-issue the same directive the founder just completed
- Move on to a new topic without engaging with what the three customers said
